name: Unfruitfulness
overview: Scripture vividly illustrates the reality and consequences of unfruitfulness through agricultural metaphors, as seen in Isaiah 5:2 where a carefully tended vineyard produces only wild grapes instead of good fruit. Jesus emphasizes the seriousness of bearing no good fruit, warning that trees without it are cut down and cast into the fire (Matthew 3:10; 7:19). The parable of the sower (Matthew 13:4-6) further highlights how unfruitfulness results from unfavorable conditions such as shallow soil and lack of root, leading to withering and loss. These passages collectively teach that genuine spiritual fruitfulness is expected and unfruitfulness leads to judgment.
